dominici_dimensions.third: One fixed ordered raw-neighbor suppression rule over fixed feature rows and a fixed graph; additive record-local statistics; ridge is the concrete learner. Corpus-dependent reclustering and encoder refitting are excluded.
dominici_dimensions.dominici_supported: Author summaries describe preparation and feature-store stages, provenance and propagated deletions; the public profile identifies a Feast extension.

dominici_dimensions.comparison: Affirmative systems-scope overlap; no demonstrated operator separation.

dominici_dimensions.comparison: Do not infer absence of sequential or canonical-state results from the summary.

dominici_dimensions.third: Original cumulative K decreases to h=K-|F|; eligibility is determined by remaining blockers; not a replenished K after each request.
